outputs: Generated textual responses for data-to-text (E2E) and mathematical reasoning tasks
natural language generation outputs on the E2E dataset

changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate model variants and merged to canonical forms. Removed GSM8k as it's primarily mathematical reasoning not NLG-focused. Consolidated task descriptions and removed redundant NLG task labels. Added LLaMA models explicitly evaluated on NLG tasks.
Normalized ROUGE-L to ROUGE base form. Removed NIST as it's not explicitly mentioned as being used in the NLG evaluation sections.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation methods are mentioned in the paper; only automatic metrics and statistical reporting are used.
No human evaluation methods or criteria are mentioned in the paper.

overall_notes: The paper primarily focuses on parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods and evaluates across multiple domains including NLG. The NLG evaluation is specifically on the E2E dataset using standard automatic metrics. No human or LLM-as-judge evaluations are conducted.
